item.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE - 2022 Youth Basketball Leagues
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Hello Parents and Guardians,

With positive COVID-19 cases increasing, Columbus Recreation and Parks is taking steps to ensure the health and safety of our participants and staff. We want to make sure that we are doing everything we can to keep our community safe. As you are already aware, practices have been suspended for this week and games have been pushed back one week. This means games will begin the week of Jan. 17. We are hoping that this will help mitigate the spread within our Community Centers. If you have already received your game schedules, please be on the lookout for updated versions to allow for these updates. Games schedules will be sent out and posted on our website.

Here are the safety measures we will be implementing order to keep our participants and staff safe:

  1. Instead of having games back to back, we will be spacing games out to allow time between games to clean the gyms. This may mean moving games to a different day, time or location.
  2. All spectators and staff will be required to wear masks at all times. Participants will be allowed to remove their mask while they actively play, but must put their masks back on if sitting on the bench. Officials will wear their masks in between games but will remove them to officiate games.
  3. We will only be allowing two spectators per player. We want to allow for social distancing and reduce the number of people in the gyms.
  4. Please bring and label your own water bottles.
  5. Everyone will have to either scan their leisure card or sign-in to enter the building for games.
  6. We have created safety plans with center staff in each of the basketball host sites to prevent crowding in the building. These plans will create opportunities for social distancing.
  7. All equipment will be sanitized prior to game start. We will also have hand sanitizer available for participants.
  8. As soon as your game is over, you will need to leave the building immediately. This allows staff the time to clean before new teams can enter the gym to warm-up and start games on time. Centers may have a separate entrance or exit location to ensure minimal grouping around doorways.
  9. If you or your participant are sick or have any symptoms of COVID-19, please do not attend the game.

We appreciate your flexibility with these safety precautions and support in trying to prevent the spread to keep the season going. If you have any questions, please email us at crpdsports@columbus.gov.

item.title: Important Youth Basketball League Information
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Good afternoon,

Thank you for registering in a Columbus Recreation and Parks Department Youth Basketball League!

The Youth Sports Office is responsible for the administration of our community sports leagues. We work with the community centers to finalize rules, uniform orders and any other logistical needs in order to run the leagues.

This year, we are looking forward to providing our participants the best youth basketball experience and we want to provide as much transparency as possible. Please find the direct link to our basketball rulebook below, so you will know exactly where to find it should any rule questions come up. Our hope is that by providing clarity with these rules, we can keep the focus on the kids.

Your local community center and coach will still be your best contact for team schedules and practice information, but if you have any questions or concerns please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

We hope you have a great season and we look forward to seeing you on the court!
